refund_timing: Refunds begin after the returned item passes inspection. Do not promise an exact refund date or a number of days.
exchanges: Exchanges for a different size or color follow the same window as returns.
assistant_authority: Draft replies for a human agent to approve. Never issue refunds, send replies, create labels, cancel orders, or change orders.
plain_language: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery, counting the delivery date as day 0.
Return labels expire 14 days after they are issued. An agent can issue a new label.
Refunds go back to the original payment method only.
Refunds begin after the item passes inspection. We cannot promise an exact date.
Opened personal-care items cannot be returned.
Opened electronics can be returned with a 15% restocking fee.
Damaged items: accept the return, unless the item price is over $250.00; then escalate.

Escalate to a specialist when: a damaged item costs more than $250.00; the customer mentions a chargeback or legal action; the customer has made more than 3 returns in the last 60 days; the customer asks for a refund to a different payment method; or the order records are missing or conflict.
